sentences.japanese: 理論上、理論と実行の間には何の違いもないが、実際上違いはあるものだ。
sentences.english: In theory, there is no difference between theory and practice. But, in practice, there is.

sentences.english: During summer breaks, I ate dinner at midnight.

sentences.english: While eating a pizza he was annoying his sister.

sentences.japanese: 君は授業に間に合いませんよ。
